# sngl:http against the local server the script harness runs at
# 127.0.0.1:47819 (internal/testhttp), decoded with sngl:json, on
# every target.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
// Requests to a local server, decoded into declared types: a path segment
// escaped, a query written from a struct, a status read off the response and
// checked, headers both ways, and a request that reaches no one.

import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import json "sngl:json"
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

const server = "http://127.0.0.1:47819"

struct Resource {
    name string
    url  string
}

struct Genre {
    rank int
    #[json.identifier("type")]
    kind Resource
}

struct Covers {
    #[json.identifier("front_url")]
    front option[string]
    #[json.identifier("back_url")]
    back  option[string]
}

struct Book {
    id        int
    title     string
    #[json.identifier("page_count")]
    pageCount option[int]
    covers    Covers
    genres    list[Genre]
}

struct Echo {
    method string
    query  string
    body   string
    header string
}

struct Page {
    limit option[int]
    #[http.identifier("page-size")]
    size  option[int]
    tags  list[string]
    q     string
}

func fetchBook(title string) async.Result[Book] {
    match var r = http.get(url="{server}/books/{http.pathEscape(title)}") {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok {
            match var checked = r.checked() {
                failed { return {failed=checked} }
                ok { return json.decode[Book](checked.body) }
            }
        }
    }
}

func echoOf(r async.Result[http.Response]) Echo {
    match var resp = r {
        ok {
            match var e = json.decode[Echo](resp.body) {
                ok { return e }
                failed { return {method="", query="", body=e.message, header=""} }
            }
        }
        failed { return {method="", query="", body=resp.message, header=""} }
    }
}

func testGetDecodes(t Test) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    match var b = fetchBook("dune") {
        ok {
            t.assert(b.id == 1)
            t.assert(b.pageCount == 412)
            t.assert(b.genres.length() == 2)
            t.assert(b.genres[1].kind.name == "adventure")
            t.assert(b.covers.front == "https://example.com/1.png")
            t.assert(b.covers.back == null)
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testPathEscape(t Test) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    t.assert(http.pathEscape("war and peace/2") == "war%20and%20peace%2F2")
    match var b = fetchBook("war and peace") {
        ok {
            t.assert(b.title == "war-and-peace")
            t.assert(b.pageCount == null)
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testNotFound(t Test) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    match var f = fetchBook("no such book") {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed {
            t.assert(f.kind == async.FailureKind.request)
            t.assert(f.code == "404")
            t.assert(f.message == "HTTP 404")
        }
    }
}

func testStatus(t Test) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    match var r = http.get(url="{server}/status/503") {
        ok {
            t.assert(r.status == 503)
            t.assert(r.body == "status 503")
            match var f = r.checked() {
                ok { t.assert(false) }
                failed { t.assert(f.kind == async.FailureKind.server) }
            }
        }
        failed { t.assert(false) }
    }
    match var r = http.get(url="{server}/status/401") {
        ok {
            match var f = r.checked() {
                ok { t.assert(false) }
                failed { t.assert(f.kind == async.FailureKind.auth) }
            }
        }
        failed { t.assert(false) }
    }
}

func testQuery(t Test) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    var e = echoOf(http.get(url="{server}/echo", query=Page{limit=20, size=null, tags=["a", "b c"], q="x&y"}))
    t.assert(e.method == "GET")
    t.assert(e.query == "limit=20&tags=a&tags=b%20c&q=x%26y")
    var sized = echoOf(http.get(url="{server}/echo?first=1", query={n=2, on=true}))
    t.assert(sized.query == "first=1&n=2&on=true")
}

func testSend(t Test) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    var r = http.send(
        method=http.Method.post,
        url="{server}/echo",
        headers={"X-Sngl" = "hello"},
        body=json.encode(Resource{name="a", url="b"}),
    )
    match var resp = r {
        ok {
            t.assert(resp.status == 200)
            t.assert(resp.headers.get("x-sngl-echo", "") == "yes")
        }
        failed { t.assert(false) }
    }
    var e = echoOf(r)
    t.assert(e.method == "POST")
    t.assert(e.header == "hello")
    t.assert(e.body == `{"name":"a","url":"b"}`)
}

func testTransport(t Test) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    match var f = http.get(url="http://127.0.0.1:1/") {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed { t.assert(f.kind == async.FailureKind.transport) }
    }
}

// A handler that waits, and a query whose answer is a request's: each
// writes after the answer arrives, which a test waits for.
func lookup(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[Echo] {
    match var r = http.get(url="{server}/echo", query={k=k}, life=life) {
        ok { return json.decode[Echo](r.body) }
        failed { return {failed=r} }
    }
}

component panel node {
    var shown = "-"
    var key = "a"
    var answer option[Echo] = null
    text #result(value=shown)
    button #ask(text="Ask", @click {
        match var r = http.get(url="{server}/echo", query={q="hi"}) {
            ok { shown = r.body }
            failed { shown = r.message }
        }
    })
    async.query(on=key, fetch=lookup, :value=answer)
    text #q(value=answer != null ? answer.query : "")
}

func testHandlerWaits(t Test, c panel) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    c.ask.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.result.value != "-", 5000)
    t.assert(c.result.value == `{"body":"","header":"","method":"GET","query":"q=hi"}`)
}

func testQueryAsks(t Test, c panel) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    t.wait(func() => c.q.value == "k=a", 5000)
    t.assert(c.q.value == "k=a")
    c.key = "b c"
    t.wait(func() => c.q.value == "k=b%20c", 5000)
    t.assert(c.q.value == "k=b%20c")
}

// An adapter's shape: the query keyed on a struct of its parameters, and a
// function literal spreading the key back out into the call that waits.
func echoKeyed(k string, n int) async.Result[Echo] {
    match var r = http.get(url="{server}/echo", query={k=k, n=n}) {
        ok { return json.decode[Echo](r.body) }
        failed { return {failed=r} }
    }
}

component adapter node {
    var key = "a"
    var answer option[Echo] = null
    async.query(on={k=key, n=2}, fetch=func(k struct { k string; n int }, life async.Lifetime) => echoKeyed(k.k, k.n), :value=answer)
    text #q(value=answer != null ? answer.query : "")
}

func testAdapterSpreadsItsKey(t Test, c adapter) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    t.wait(func() => c.q.value == "k=a&n=2", 5000)
    t.assert(c.q.value == "k=a&n=2")
}

window {
    panel
    adapter
}
